technical_issues.where: DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship
technical_issues.issue: Arithmetic error: 1 percent of 5,000 stated as 500 failed servers; correct is 50.
Volkswagen case mischaracterised as electric vehicles and crash-safety tests; actual scandal was diesel vehicles with emissions defeat devices.

overall: Balanced for/against discussion with relevant cases supports Not Ship, but quantitative error, factual error, missing abstract and visuals limit marks.

feedback.summary: Well done — you built a balanced for/against discussion in DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship that supports your Not Ship conclusion in The Most Ethical Path. You linked ethical issues to design and used relevant cases well. To improve, correct factual details, deepen stakeholder coverage, and strengthen structure and visuals.
next_steps: Add an abstract and one stakeholder table or figure to support your discussion, then proofread and consistently format your References.
Correct 1% of 5,000 to 50 and revise the Volkswagen case to diesel emissions defeat devices with accurate evidence.
Extend your RECOMMENDATION beyond Rachel/company to give tailored decision guidance for end-users and the chip contractor.

criteria.C1: You linked quality-safety vs business success to design well in INTRODUCTION and listed stakeholders including Rachel. To reach Excellent, deepen significance of each issue and show both organisational context and stakeholder interests in depth.
criteria.C2: You presented three for and two against arguments in DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship with good depth to support Not Ship. To reach Excellent, extend decision guidance beyond Rachel/company to several different stakeholders with tailored recommendations.
criteria.C3: Your Most Ethical Path conclusion follows logically from your for/against structure and covers end-users and company well. To reach Very good, make arguments fully compelling for all stakeholders, especially developing the chip contractor coverage systematically.
criteria.C4: You used NHS, VW, Apple cases and EACE well in The Most Ethical Path. To reach Very good, correct your quantitative evidence (1% of 5,000 is 50) and VW facts to diesel emissions defeat devices, and ensure balanced qualitative and quantitative support.
criteria.C5: Your report reads fluently overall with relevant references. To move to Good, add the missing abstract, add limited visuals like a stakeholder table/figure, fix typos, and format References consistently with complete structured entries.
